nodes.rationale: Container boots once per worker; request state in singletons/statics leaks into later requests.

nodes.label: Consistency First Ground Rule
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Majority codebase style is the convention; document reality, never propose a better pattern.

nodes.label: Consistency First (Testing)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Project test conventions take precedence over the skill; do not rewrite existing tests.

nodes.label: Feature Test First
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Write unit tests only for logic that does not use the framework.

nodes.label: Subagent Fan-Out Sweep
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Sweep is embarrassingly parallel; hand each checklist group to its own subagent.

nodes.label: Architecture Choices Are the Gold
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Structural patterns (Actions, Services, DTOs, query objects) and deliberate absences are highest-signal conventions no tool can decide.

nodes.label: Evidence or Silence Bar
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Needs at least 3 consistent examples and no meaningful rival.

nodes.label: Record Decisions Not Defaults
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Only record a pattern if without the rule the next agent would plausibly write it differently.

nodes.label: Tooling-Owned Skip Rule
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Skip forms Pint/Rector produce; record only against-the-grain holds a tool would refactor away.

nodes.rationale: Authentication is not permission; validation is not authorization

nodes.label: Cross-field validation after
nodes.rationale: Validation against mutable state does not prevent races; enforce with DB constraints

nodes.label: Real Database in Tests
nodes.rationale: Mocking the query builder only asserts the mock.

nodes.label: Built-in Laravel Assertion Methods
nodes.rationale: Hand-built checks fail with 'false is not true'; framework assertions name the wrong value.

nodes.label: Contracts at boundaries
nodes.rationale: Justified when testability or interchangeable implementations matter

nodes.rationale: Avoid app()/resolve() hidden dependencies

nodes.norm_label: test authorization at the policy level

nodes.label: Tenant Isolation 404 over 403
nodes.rationale: 403 confirms the other tenant's record exists.

nodes.label: Which Layer Owns Which Case
nodes.rationale: Rule-class test owns the value matrix; endpoint test keeps one case to prove wiring.

nodes.label: Atomic locks
nodes.rationale: Lease must exceed callback runtime

nodes.label: ShouldBeUnique
nodes.rationale: Uses cache lock; not substitute for idempotency

nodes.label: Global scopes sparingly
nodes.rationale: Silently modify every query

nodes.label: Model-aware queries
nodes.rationale: Preserve casts, scopes, table config; migrations use explicit table names

nodes.label: Immutable deployed migrations
nodes.rationale: Editing makes fresh installs differ from upgraded

nodes.label: defer post-response work
nodes.rationale: Lightweight work without retries/durability

nodes.label: Cache remember
nodes.rationale: Manual get/put treats falsy values as misses

nodes.label: Keep queries out of Blade
nodes.rationale: Keeps query behavior visible and testable

nodes.norm_label: each test makes its own data
nodes.rationale: Keeps setup visible; setUp objects stay in memory until suite end.
